## Speaker
Yiyi Wan

### Theme
An Introduction to Rational Conformal Field Theory

### Abstract
In this talk, we will give an introductory overview of Rational Conformal Field Theory (RCFT) and discuss the vertex operator algebra (VOA) approach. The goal is to prepare for Chenxi’s presentation next week on the paper by Kong and Zheng (arXiv:1705.01087).
